note.title: Canada tariff retaliation is now in force
note.body: Canada put CA$27.6bn of retaliatory tariffs into effect after talks collapsed. Ottawa is signalling it will absorb the hit rather than settle quickly, so this is a standing CAD risk rather than a headline that passes. Watch whether BoC language shifts from growth to inflation pass-through.
